title: Martinis at the Smoke House
overview: In the new short comedy "Martinis at the Smoke House" the career-embattled actors Barney and Rollin, who's tumultuous time in Tinseltown has worn them to the bone. During one particular vodka soaked martini session at the legendary Hollywood Smoke House restaurant- the evening takes a fateful turn when memories mix with magic to produce a destiny for the friends that is truly fit for old time Hollywood.
